30

  • N: lūman lā (|) bēlu | umašširanni
  • T: Had it not been that the lord released me,
  • L: lūman ← lūman I “O/jB modal adv.”; lā ← lā I “not, no”; bēlu ← bēlu I “lord”; umašširanni ← wašāru I “~ to sink down”
  • Note: [RN3205: 280] suggests that the beginning of the line should be read lūman lā instead of lū mannu, thus introducing a conditional clause. The commentary on this line, equating lūman with inanna (courtesy of E. Jiménez), confirms this interpretation. The same equation is also found in a commentary on Neo-Babylonian grammatical texts (lu-man : i-na-an-na; see [RN2103: 79 l. 16] and [RN3048ff: l. 16]).
